notes.title: The Roopocket Trophy Update
notes.notes:
Good morning Captains, ːsteamhappyː

Welcome back to the universe of Roopocket. After some feedback we decided to add and change a couple of things in the game. Let's jump into it:

Trophies
After mastering the 20 levels with one of your rockets you will receive an award of this rocket with the rocket-worth placed in your garage! You can find them by looking to the right in the garage.

The Cubus-3E
This amazing piece of rocket-technology is able to get a boost upwards. With its modern and artstylish design it is a rocket for true rocket-collectors.

The new Level
Level 12 is now shining in a new colorful design. It is more challenging and more fun!

Achivements
Roopocket does now have some new achivements to unlock. But we are planing to add others.

Style
We changed a lot in the UI. For example we added a background behind health, fuel and time...AMAZING! No, we really tried to make the game look more beautiful! 
In the Main Menu we added a manual. Take a look at it! It will explain the game to you!

PvP
Local PvP does work now! ːsteamhappyː

And the leaderboard is back! Challenge everyone in the world to become the fastest Roopocket Player ever!

notes.title: Splitscreen Beta and Controller Support Update
notes.notes:
Gooood morning

in this glorious update we adressed a lot of bugs and feature requests from players to improve the games usability. Furthermore we added a PvP splitscreen mode because we want to and we can.

In the PvP you try to destroy your opponents rocket or bring him to empty his fuel first to win a round. There is no round limit at the moment, as we just try out this mode. We included one battle map and you can play with all the rockets you own.

Here is a full list with all the changes:


Splitscreen PvP added
Controller support for ingame gameplay, not for the menu yet
Added visible hints for refueling stations and goals to distinguish them
Added a new rocket
Fixed bugging landing arms for many rockets
Switched easy and medium rocket as the medium rocket was easier to fly than the easy one
Rocket balancing tweaks


See you in space you crazy captains!

notes.title: Release-Followup
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

after we received a lot of feedback from players, whilst experiencing some things ourself, we adressed some issues and added some new helpful features.

I guess most importantly we added some hints that appear ingame to help you through the levels. Furthermore we've got two new rockets and a lot of minor fixes. Here's a list with all the things we updated.


Added hint that appears when using a lot of fuel
Added hint for the new big rocket to explain the special controls
Fixed bug where one rocket didn't receive damage
Added new rocket inspired by a Youtuber
Added new rocket inspired by Elon Musk
Fixed minor bugs in Level 12 and 15
Reworked the tutorial
Made the easy rocket more easy to fly (hopefully)


That's it for this 5 days, if you encounter any problems or have any feedback please let us know we're so happy if we can listen to you.

Have a good one!
